items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1955-07-26
items.q: Brother James, that was a very nice little speech that you made.

ctx.x: This is Brother James from Dayton, Ohio, wishing you all a very happy and prosperous summer. As we end into the fall season of the year, we trust that God's blessings will rain upon you. As you go into the winter months and the snows will fall upon the ground that you might provide for yourself a place of rest and place of worship.
Brother James, that was a very nice little speech that you made. I don't know why you thought of the idea of a place of rest.

Most people go into the winter months without providing for themselves a place to stay. They don't consider the Bible when it says go to the Ants out of the summer and consider ways to be wise and ants and doors up in the storehouses in the summer. They might have a place in the winter for rest.
